name: Void Terminus
description: Where consumed dimensions end and reality itself frays into nothing. OG Nike maintains his eternal vigil here, catching the souls of Nikes killed by Nolem before they can be absorbed. Four broken Legendaries guard the path to Nolem's Maw, and an ancient dragon stands at the final gate.

atmosphere.visual: Void, stardust trails, dead dimensions, the shimmer of consumed realities
atmosphere.mood: Desolate, vast, haunted, but with unexpected hope
atmosphere.danger: Void beasts, dimensional currents, absolute despair, existential threats

charles.name: Void Charles
charles.title: The Witness
charles.description: Has watched dimensions die. His testimony is all that remains of consumed worlds.
charles.wisdom: Remembering is its own form of resistance
charles.backstory: Stationed at the edge where reality ends. Records the names and histories of consumed dimensions so they are not forgotten entirely.

ogNike.name: OG Nike
ogNike.title: The Template
ogNike.role: Active guardian, not just exhausted remnant. Catches souls of every Nike killed by Nolem's forces before absorption. Has done this for three thousand years.
keyMoments: Warns Walker about four Legendary guardians blocking the path
Reveals he never earned Elbonzys Nike's respect
First to speak the 5,555 prophecy aloud
Gives blessing before Walker enters Nolem's Maw
ogNike.quote: Three thousand years. Give or take. I catch their souls before he can absorb them. If I stop, even for a moment, he gets stronger.

harbinger.name: Abyssal Horror
harbinger.title: The Consumed
harbinger.emotionalTheme: Complete despair — survived what destroyed everyone else
harbinger.corruptionReason: Watched entire dimension consumed by Nolem. Sole survivor. Grief became monstrous.
harbinger.description: Most alien Harbinger. Barely recognizable as the Collector he once was. Emanates despair rather than speaking.

act2Legendaries.name: Cosmic Nike
act2Legendaries.description: A figure of stardust and void. Stars born and die within him in seconds. Corruption is nihilism.

act2Legendaries.name: Phoenix Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Endless death-rebirth cycle. Each flame a scream of 'please let me rest.' The undying flame.

act2Legendaries.name: Cardano Whale Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Massive beyond comprehension. Searches endlessly for his pod — his family — whose names he can no longer remember. Grief that became an ocean.

act2Legendaries.name: Elbonzys Nike
act2Legendaries.description: Ancient dragon gatekeeper. NOT corrupted — a test to be passed, not corruption to be broken. Guards the entrance to Nolem's Maw.

regionBoss.name: The Dimension Eater
regionBoss.title: THE DEVOURER OF WORLDS
regionBoss.note: Narrative-only, no purify path, not a Nike, not catchable. The gate on the road to OG Nike — NOT the region anchor and NOT the completion boss. The shipped node carries isRegionBoss:false and isAnchorBoss:false; region completion runs on the Abyssal Horror. 'No region anchor — the bottom of the world is not a boss' stands, and always did.
regionBoss.arc: It does not fall — it changes. It discovers it preserved rather than destroyed, the Collector names it an ark, and it opens the road to OG Nike.

locations.name: The Edge
locations.description: Where reality begins to fray into nothing

locations.name: OG Nike's Vigil
locations.description: Where the Template maintains his eternal watch

locations.name: Stardust Trail
locations.description: Where Cosmic Nike drifts among dying stars

locations.name: Deep Currents
locations.description: Dimensional rivers where Cardano Whale Nike searches

locations.name: The Final Gate
locations.description: Elbonzys Nike's dragon gate — last barrier before Nolem's Maw

locations.name: The Ember
locations.description: Last spark of a consumed dimension. A side encounter.

locations.name: Dimension Maw
locations.description: A mouth at the edge of existence. The Dimension Eater's post — before the turn, and after it

dimensionalAnchor.name: Final Fragment
dimensionalAnchor.description: A piece of OG Nike's original power — the last anchor needed to challenge Nolem.
dimensionalAnchor.obtainedFrom: OG Nike, given freely — NOT a boss drop. Void Terminus has no anchor Legendary and no region boss to defeat for it; see legendaryNikeNote in dimensions/index.json. The region's boss, the Dimension Eater, does not grant it.
dimensionalAnchor.note: The sixth and final anchor. The other five are granted on their region boss's defeat; this one is a gift, which is why the bottom of the world can be bossless and still complete the set.

primeEraConnection.note: Void Terminus formed where Nike Prime and Nolem vanished. Near the original trap location.
